purpose: Teach: 國/瓦/梁/メス/霊的/孤児/村人/住職

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、本気で、絶対、國、絶対、字、絶対、と、絶対、旧字、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, I was genuinely impressed by how thoroughly you handled the historical uses of old Chinese characters in your paper.
lines.style: Warm, steady tone. Slight lean forward with genuine interest. Brief pause before the compliment, as if to ensure she's being heard. Even pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。古建築の、本気で、絶対、瓦、絶対、技法、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I really wanted to explore the ancient roofing techniques in traditional architecture deeply—it meant a lot to research something that careful.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Eyes steady on the teacher. Slower pace, choosing words with care. Slight breathiness on the gratitude, not performing it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統建築の、本気で、絶対、梁、絶対、構造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you examined the beam structures in classical buildings was really thoughtful work.
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Nods slightly as she speaks. Warm but not effusive. The tone of someone noting something that matters, said once and well.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。手術用の、本気で、絶対、メス、絶対、の、絶対、歴史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to trace how surgical instruments developed over time—there was so much depth to uncover there, and I'm grateful for the chance to do it.
lines.style: Direct and earnest. No softening or self-deprecation. Speaks from genuine investment. Steady breath, grounded in the chair.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、霊的、絶対、な、絶対、儀礼、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of spiritual ritual practices in those historical contexts showed real insight.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Slight lift in energy—noticing something important. Clear diction. Not scanning ahead, fully there with the observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦災、本気で、絶対、孤児、絶対、の、絶対、ケア、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on how communities cared for war orphans and what that tells us about resilience—it was difficult material, but necessary research.
lines.style: Calm gravity. Voice doesn't waver but carries weight. Speaking about something serious without dramatizing it. Slow, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 限界集落の、本気で、絶対、村人、絶対、生活、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: I was struck by how you documented the daily lives of people in those depopulating rural villages—that's the kind of work that preserves what matters.
lines.style: Thoughtful and slower. Genuine admiration in the rhythm. Pauses before key words to let them land. Voice settles toward the end—respect, not performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。お寺の、本気で、絶対、住職、絶対、の、絶対、伝統、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to capture the traditions kept alive by temple priests—their knowledge, their role—it felt important to record that carefully and honor it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Almost solemn tone but not cold. Speaking something she believes in. Slight warmth beneath the seriousness. Trails softly at the very end.
